message: 予兆と疑念

name: Lolotte
message: 「Madam Chairwoman. Why are we in the library?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, I'm about to introduce a very reliable helper!」

name: Synn
message: 「A helper, in the library...?」
Could it be...

name: Helena
message: 「Look, here she comes」

name: Melilot
message: 「Would anyone care for some tea?」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Melilot!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could our helper be...」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right! Our dependable, reckless daredevil, Melilot!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't give me weird titles\s10」

name: Helena
message: 「You see, while working as the librarian, Melilot also keeps watch over Re-Crea」

name: Ria
message: 「Over Re-Crea...?」

name: Helena
message: 「And what's more, she took down one of the Demon Generals lurking in the academy all by herself!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A Demon General...!?」

name: Misa
message: 「All by herself!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see, I believe her name was Soltia or something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've never even heard of her...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, she's not even a Crusader, so where did she get that kind of power?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, you know. Melilot is a demon, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaaat!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Among the demons, she's one of our allies who has been working alongside the Kujo family for ages to prepare against Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it is...」

name: Helena
message: 「Sorry for keeping it a secret. It's just that Melilot is quite shy」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's not what I mean. It's simply that our duties differ from those of the Student Council」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, getting all sulky like that\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「As I've told you before, Helena……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Regarding Re-Crea, things are progressing smoothly for now. There are no problems whatsoever」

name: Melilot
message: 「Leave the rest to me, and please fulfill your duties as students」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then……」

name: Helena
message: 「Hold on, Melilot. The Crusaders have worked hard up until now too, so at least hear them out a little」

name: Melilot
message: 「I told you about my true identity, didn't I? Talking any further might just end up putting unnecessary pressure on them」

name: Helena
message: 「Always talking back--I Love You. Sorry about her. Melilot's a shut-in, so she's pretty bad at communicating」

name: Melilot
message: 「Excuse me……?」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san! What we want you to hear isn't about Re-Crea, it's, well……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's about a friend of ours」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Before that……. There is something I must tell everyone on the Student Council」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The truth is, I…… am actually an angel!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. And?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-Huh…… Why isn't anyone surprised?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, you see」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How should I put it\s02」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course I'm not surprised. I've known about that from the very beginning」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-Whaaaat!?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well…… yeah\s02」

name: Melilot
message: 「And I also know that Sakura-kun is the Demon King」

name: Synn
message: 「Pffft!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!! What do you think you're doing!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How do you know about that......」

name: Helena
message: 「BINGO♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems it was true after all.」
I-I got tricked into confessing!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heeh~~. So Synn was the Demon Lord.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun!! What is the meaning of 'Demon Lord'!?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-Now, now, Misa-chan. Why don't the two of us go outside and have a little talk alone\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「W-With Onee-sama, mph......!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Leaving Misa-chan's persuasion to Ria......」

name: Helena
message: 「What kind of discussion were the two of you--an angel and a Demon Lord--planning to have, I wonder?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, you see. My childhood friend, an angel named Amyrina, has also come to the Human World just like me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Sigh*...... Angels going out of their way to set foot in the Human World during the time of Re-Crea. Honestly, both of you are so reckless.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They don't normally do that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Because there's no telling what might happen during Re-Crea, the rule is to lay low in Heaven, where it's as safe as possible.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Assuming it's actually safe...... that is.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, despite that rule, there is one more angel who has come to the Human World.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And that is Azel-san.」

name: Helena
message: 「I see. So Azel-chan really was an angel after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Didn't I tell you? Angels love using the Principality of Sharo-Ma cover story.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unlike us, Azel-san didn't come to the Human World just to play around.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina told me she is participating as part of a Re-Crea investigation team.」

name: Melilot
message: 「So the angels really did send an investigation team after all……」

name: Helena
message: 「Going to such lengths means they must view the influence as quite strong」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why we've been offering to help too, yet they won't listen to us at all……」

name: Helena
message: 「So that's why you've been sticking together lately. To get closer to them」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. However, it's not just about getting closer--we're worried」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel…… only occasionally, though, hasn't been feeling well. Even collapsed once before」

name: Melilot
message: 「I hear that when ectoplasm transmutes into physical matter, it can sometimes cause physical abnormalities」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You even know about that……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, it isn't an effect of transmutation. Azel's body is――」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Slowly reverting back into ectoplasm」

name: Helena
message: 「Huh……」

name: Melilot
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「We don't have concrete proof. Still, the fact that something abnormal is happening to Azel's body is certain」

name: Melilot
message: 「Isn't our only choice to ask directly?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even if we ask Azel, it would be like driving nails into the \{floor|\s12}」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, that's a problem」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, allow me to conduct an interrogation」

name: Melilot
message: 「If they're keeping their lips sealed, we'll simply have to force the truth out, even if it's rough」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No, we couldn't do that……!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we push too hard and make their condition worse or something……」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, if we put off the interrogation, wouldn't it end up being too late?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I believe doing something for Azel is for the best. Am I wrong?」

name: Helena
message: 「Alright, that's enough. You're an adult too, Melilot, so don't go using words like 'interrogation'」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, you're willing to hear us out.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, as there are matters I am personally curious about.」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, just be honest and call it kindness!」
Melilot keeps making rather harsh remarks. However, what she is saying makes complete sense.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel...」
Hearing that, Lolotte looks uneasy.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. If anything happens, we'll protect Azel. Everything will be fine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...! Yes, you're right!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Unnecessary.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Honestly, Azel!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sigh... I see. So that is what is going on.」

name: Azel
message: 「I told you there was no need to worry. And yet--」

name: Azel
message: 「To think you would reveal our true identities to some shady Demon.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not it! We can't solve this on our own. That's why I thought we could ask for her guidance--」

name: Azel
message: 「...Tch. Mind your own business!」

name: Azel
message: 「Selling your soul to a Demon of all things... You traitor!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel! You don't have to put it like that--」

name: Melilot
message: 「For an angel, this is a completely normal reaction. It is simply that Lolotte is far too eccentric.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even you, Melilot...」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you still trying to put on an angel's airs!」

name: Azel
message: 「Extending a helping hand to me, your own brethren--」

name: Synn
message: 「No! That's not what Lolotte is doing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte isn't trying to help you just because you're an angel or because she's an angel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte is trying to help you because you're a 'comrade'... because you're a friend.」

name: Azel
message: 「A comrade... you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「The rest of us who want to help feel the exact same way. Even so, because Lolotte is an angel, she's the one who can understand you best, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Despite all that, why are you rejecting her...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President...」

name: Synn
message: 「If she were the kind of angel you and Melilot think of, she would've worried about her own safety and returned to Heaven right away.」

name: Synn
message: 「In fact, even Amyrina tried to persuade her to evacuate. And yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte told us she'd stay in the Human World and face Re-Crea alongside us. She stayed here in the Human World.」

name: Synn
message: 「How can you say you can't trust someone like her...」

name: Azel
message: 「That woman said it herself just now. Lolotte is eccentric--an imperfect being far removed from any angel I know.」

name: Azel
message: 「How could I possibly trust the words of someone like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad Lolotte is an eccentric angel. Thank goodness she's imperfect.」

name: Synn
message: 「If she weren't, she might have abandoned you, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Silence!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Stop... disturbing my heart any further... Do not nurture thoughts unbecoming of an angel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You still don't know, Azel! Just how wonderful and amazing life here truly is.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, together, let's--」

name: Azel
message: 「Lead me astray no longer!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel...!」
Along with a voice sounding as though it might tear apart, an extraordinary intensity surges forth from Azel.
Could she be bearing something heavy and sorrowful beyond all imagination?
What on earth is Azel concealing, and what is she about to set in motion?

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why I want you to tell me what's troubling you! If you do, I know we'll be able to understand each other!」

name: Azel
message: 「It is... no longer something that can be settled by talking...」
As her words trailed off toward the end, the strength drained away from Azel.
His intimidating aura gone and left speechless, Azel heads toward his room with weak, heavy steps.
His back looked surprisingly smaller than the usual figure of Azel I'm used to seeing.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's call it a day here」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Yes, let's」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, don't you feel like Azel is gradually starting to open up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, you think so too, President! What a coincidence~~ Actually, I was just thinking the exact same thing!」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's the case, we're almost there... Let's keep at it without giving up!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That sheer intensity--no, a kind of Spirit Power... He can't fully control it with his own ego...」

name: Melilot
message: 「To possess that much power... Enough to make me break out in such a cold sweat is completely unexpected」

name: Melilot
message: 「Could Azel be... an existence that sets itself apart from ordinary angels...?」
